regions.name: Low Elevation Areas
regions.where: West, south-west, south and south-east lowlands: Hirat, Badghis, Faryab, Jawzjan, Farah, Nimroz, Hilmand, Kandahar, Zabul, plus Paktika, Paktya and Khost (purple on the locator map). The north (Balkh to Badakhshan) and the Kabul/Nangarhar east are grey on both maps.

harvest.name: Rice, maize harvest (summer crop, outside any rainy season)

regions.notes: Winter Rains shading runs Jan to mid-Mar and Spring Rains mid-Mar to end-May; a thin white line splits them at mid-Mar, so Mar is in both. The lean box is drawn in two pieces, mid-Dec to Dec and Jan to end-Mar, and is recorded as one 12-3. Wheat/barley harvest runs Apr to mid-Jun and poppy harvest mid-Apr to end-Jun. Rice/maize planting runs Jun to mid-Jul and harvest mid-Sep to mid-Nov. Spring wheat planting runs mid-Feb to Apr and winter wheat planting Oct to mid-Dec.

regions.name: High Elevation Areas
regions.where: Central highlands: Bamyan, Daykundi, central/southern Ghor, northern Uruzgan, western Wardak and southern Sar-e-Pul (purple on the locator map), plus one small separate purple patch north-east of Kabul
regions.notes: Winter Rains shading runs Jan to mid-Mar and Spring Rains mid-Mar to mid-Jun (Jun counted as half). Wheat/barley harvest runs mid-Jul to mid-Oct and winter wheat planting mid-Oct to mid-Dec, so half months are counted at both ends. Spring wheat planting runs Mar to end-Apr.

assign.method: Provinces purple on a locator map take that block. Provinces grey on both maps take the block of similar elevation and timing: the northern plains and the Nangarhar/Laghman/Kunar valleys go to Low; Kabul, Kapisa, Parwan, Logar, Panjsher, Ghazni, Nuristan and Badakhshan go to High. Northern lowland Sar-e-Pul districts get Low adm2 overrides.

transcriber_notes: Both locator maps leave the north (Balkh, Kunduz, Takhar, Baghlan, Samangan, Badakhshan) and the east-central provinces (Kabul, Kapisa, Parwan, Panjsher, Logar, Ghazni, Nangarhar, Laghman, Kunar, Nuristan) grey, so those assignments are inferred from elevation (low/medium confidence). The small separate purple patch on the high map, north-east of Kabul (Kapisa or Panjsher?), could not be identified. Ghor and Uruzgan straddle the two maps; no district boundaries could be resolved from the small locator. Wheat/barley harvest links are judgement calls: Low is linked to Winter Rains because its harvest starts in Apr, while Spring Rains are still falling; High is linked to Spring Rains because its harvest starts after them.
